data.completion_memo: Implemented shared supervised process sessions with independent tree monitoring, file-spooled output, bounded nonblocking stdin queue and soft output waits. Windows Job Objects own descendants before resume and kill on handle close; host application crates retain unsafe prohibition. Legacy ProcessRunner now waits on the full tree and cannot block joining inherited output pipes. Native process-session regressions: 3 passed; host shell regression suite: 4 passed including GUI-parent no-console checks; host network: 2 passed, 1 intentionally ignored. cargo check host and desktop passed. No Adashi QA changes.
data.description: Implement exact process-tree monitoring, bounded asynchronous output and stdin, resource limits, soft wait snapshots, cleanup after root exit, no console windows, and native lifecycle tests. Introduce a minimal audited OS boundary if required; preserve existing safe application code.
data.title: Implement supervised process sessions and repair descendant/output cancellation
